test_title: PYST 71: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

P) always favours

Q) only the

R) fortune

S) bold
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **RPQS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence logically starts with "Fortune" which is correctly indicated by **part (R).**
 
• **Following this,** "always favours" (**P**) continues the sentence, indicating what fortune does.
 
• **Next,** "only the" (**Q**) specifies the subject that fortune favours.
 
• **Ending with** "bold" (**S**) completes the sentence by describing which group is favoured by fortune.

Therefore, the correct answer is **RPQS.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (SQPR):** This option starts with "bold" which leaves the sentence incomplete.
 
• **Option 3 (SRQP):** This option starts with "bold," similarly leaving the sentence incomplete and lacking context.
 
• **Option 4 (PQRS):** This option starts with "always favours," which does not logically lead to "only the" without starting with a proper subject.
